newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts Nu Skin Asia.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts Nu Skin Asia.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc as near-term accumulate and as long-term buy.
-- Merrill Lynch was the lead underwriter of Nu Skin's November 22 initial public offering.
-- Merrill Lynch sees Nu Skin Asia earnings $0.90 a share in 1996, up from $0.36 a share in 1995. For 1997, Merrill said it sees Nu Skin earning $1.20 a share.
-- Nu Skin's balance sheet is strong with $161 million in cash, $87 million in debt and $102 million in stockholder's equity. Merrill sees Nu Skin generating $80 million in free cash flow in 1997.
-- For the fourth quarter, Merrill expects Nu SKin to generate sales of $185 million, up about 55-60 percent from last year.
-- In 1997, sales growth is expected to be 33 percent, with earnings per share growth expected to be in the mid-30 percent range, Merrill said.
-- Merrill also said Nu Skin may initiate a dividend over the next 12 months.
